description: Source code for JPEG image parsing and data extraction in Android's stagefright media framework.

classes.name: JPEGSource
classes.description: Class for parsing JPEG images and providing image metadata and data streams.

methods.name: parseJPEG
methods.description: Parses JPEG headers to extract image width and height.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes buffer group and prepares for reading JPEG data.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Releases resources associated with JPEG data reading.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns metadata about the JPEG image, including MIME type, dimensions, and size.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads JPEG data into a buffer, supporting seeking.
